h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kharagpur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Kharagpur

c: Between IIT Kharagpur, the railway colonies and the air force station at Kalaikunda nearby, Kharagpur has more large campuses than most towns its size. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to campuses, hostels, railway colonies, schools and parks in Kharagpur. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,530 km away, and travel to West Bengal by road.

Hostel students tend to use an outdoor gym late in the evening, so lighting and a central spot matter more than shade. Railway colony users come early in the morning. We plan the layout around those habits. West Bengal's monsoon is heavy, so the frames are galvanised and the seats roto-moulded. Our team or a dealer in eastern India installs each machine. Send us the campus plan and tell us who will use the gym.

items.q: Is a multi gym a good choice for a hostel?
items.a: Yes. A multi gym puts several stations on one frame, so a group can train together in a small space. Add a cardio machine for students who want a warm-up.

items.q: Can the gym be used late in the evening?
items.a: Yes, if the area is lit. The machines need no power to work. Place the gym near existing lights or plan new light points on the layout.

items.q: Do you supply outdoor gyms in Kharagpur?
items.a: Yes. Kharagpur is about 1,530 km from Vasai. We dispatch by road and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
